 Articles

1. In Blockchain We Trust: The Legal Paradigm of Smart Contracts Across Borders
 - Status: Completed, https://medium.com/@littlefishfoundation/in-blockchain-we-trust-the-legal-paradigm-of-smart-contracts-across-borders-1351523e5243
 - Summary: This article tackles the legal aspects of smart contracts, particularly how they stand in various jurisdictions. It highlights complexities and provides general guidance on what to expect.
2. Crypto Conundrum: Navigating the Maze of Assets & Regulations Across Borders
 - Status: Completed, https://medium.com/@littlefishfoundation/crypto-conundrum-navigating-the-maze-of-assets-regulations-across-borders-8ce0a849e01c
 - Summary: The article dissects the regulations around crypto assets across different legal frameworks. It serves as a navigational guide for the community to understand the regulatory maze they might encounter.
3. Beyond the Hype: The Legal Weight of Crypto-Asset White Papers Across Jurisdictions
 - Status: Completed, https://medium.com/@littlefishfoundation/beyond-the-hype-the-legal-weight-of-crypto-asset-white-papers-across-jurisdictions-a42795306db9
 - Summary: This article focuses on the legal implications of white papers in the crypto landscape. It educates the community on how these documents are viewed from a legal standpoint across different jurisdictions.

 Workshop

 - Status: Completed, https://youtu.be/S_z9U_aflUg

Articles
・The ICO Phenomenon: Legal Perspectives on Crypto Crowdfunding Status: Completed, https://medium.com/@littlefishfoundation/the-ico-phenomenon-legal-perspectives-on-crypto-crowdfunding-c99fa35783e8
・Summary: This article explores the evolution of crowdfunding, with a focus on Initial Coin Offerings (ICOs) as a modern, technology-driven method. It categorizes crowdfunding into donation, reward, lending, and equity models, and discusses the legalities and risks associated with ICOs. The article compares traditional crowdfunding with ICOs, highlighting ICOs' accessibility and potential risks like market manipulation and regulatory challenges. It emphasizes the importance of understanding legal implications in the evolving landscape of crypto crowdfunding.
・Decoding the Digital Frontier: Exploring the Intersection of Intellectual Property and Blockchain Status: Completed, https://medium.com/@littlefishfoundation/decoding-the-digital-frontier-exploring-the-intersection-of-intellectual-property-and-blockchain-2df1f77b9d97
・Summary: examines the synergy between blockchain technology and intellectual property (IP) rights. It begins with an overview of blockchain, highlighting its security, transparency, and efficiency. The article then delves into the concept of IP, emphasizing its importance in protecting the creations of human intellect. It explores how blockchain can enhance the IP rights system by providing a secure, transparent, and efficient method for registering and managing IP. The article discusses the potential of blockchain in simplifying the registration process for IP rights, managing IP contracts, and enforcing IP rights in the marketplace. It also covers the use of smart contracts in IP management and the role of blockchain in establishing a secure platform for verifying IP ownership.
